summary: A Paddington estate agent appears to lose landlords and sellers to placeholder Lorem ipsum text in its Our Services section.

findings.problem: The Our Services section appears to show placeholder Lorem ipsum text under Sales, Request Valuation, Contact us, Commercial Sales and Commercial Lettings.
findings.cost: Landlords and sellers read this section to decide whether to call, and dummy text tells them the business is careless.
findings.fix: Real service copy for every card.

findings.problem: The page is a long single page of sections with the same short text repeated in each block.
findings.cost: Visitors skim, find no proof, and move to an agent that shows results.
findings.fix: Short sections with results, reviews and a clear next step.

findings.problem: No WhatsApp appears next to the phone number.
findings.cost: Landlords with a quick question message first, and the agent who answers first gets the valuation.
findings.fix: A one tap WhatsApp button and a valuation form.
